notes: Not all standard: GSM5550331-36 are in vitro Cas13a digests of purified total RNA (assay_class other; no growth labels). In vivo samples: rRNA-depleted, RppH/PNK-treated, sonicated to ~200 nt, NEBNext Small RNA kit, analysed by 5' end counts; labelled total_rnaseq because the fragmentation is ordinary sonication of whole RNA, but the protocol is designed to capture degradation products (could be argued end_mapping). All in vivo cells carry LshCas13a + crRNA plasmids (heterologous_expression) and are aTc-induced; targeting vs nontargeting differ by spacer, no reference-genotype control, so is_control left out. C3000 strain group not stated (left out); D10 parent not stated. M13 samples: phage, timing of infection not given (exposure left out). Growth phase not stated (1 h after 1:100 dilution, no OD).
